description: Monument-specific inputs for dia_preflight Wave 1 gates. mention_grounding.exempt_ids: show host, speaks in first person and is rarely named. mention_grounding.reviewed: human-verified Mentions where the person is referenced by role rather than name; each row is also recorded in audits/wave1/mentions_decisions.csv. first_name_ok: ids that may ground on the first name alone (Charlie, Erika). window_seconds: grounding window in seconds around the claim timestamp; window_seconds_early applies to episodes up to early_max_episode (coarser early drafts). A placeholder 00:00:00 to 00:00:01 timestamp falls back to episode-wide grounding.

dash_rule.note: Daveed, 8 Oct 2026: in prose an em dash (U+2014) becomes an en dash (U+2013) and a dash is never rewritten as a comma, period, colon, semicolon, parentheses or a spaced hyphen. Quote fields (Transcript Snippet, Quote, quoted spans) stay exact to the transcript, em dashes included. prose_em_dash (P2) flags an em dash outside a quote; quote_dash_fidelity (P1) flags a quote whose dashes differ from the transcript.

ledger_intro.note: Wave 2.1: a node is introduced by the New, Hole-minted or Tip-minted ledger line of its first appearance; Reused-before-New and register rows without such a line fail (cited_before_intro, intro_missing).

person_band_lock.note: Person band lock (Daveed via Transit, 2026-10-08, re-audit of PR 62 at b558034), in force until Daveed rules on band capacity. N-1..N-999 is full: every id is an active person, a tombstone (config/retired_node_ids.json retired) or a reserved episode_000 baseline id. NEVER reuse a retired or tombstoned id, NEVER mint a person at N-1000 or above, and keep canonical next_person_id null. Any new person found by the daily run goes into the audit triage as DEFER with the reason "person band full, awaiting Daveed"; claims may still name the person in prose, with no Mentions id. Gate: person_band_lock (P1).
